title: Headline Monthly Trade in Goods
description: Monthly exports, imports, total trade, and trade balance statistics for Malaysia.

fields.name: series
fields.title: Series Type
fields.description: [Categorical] Either absolute values ('abs'), year-on-year growth ('growth_yoy') or month-on-month growth ('growth_mom')

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 since the data is at monthly frequency

fields.name: exports_domestic
fields.title: Domestic Exports
fields.description: [Float, RM] Domestic exports, i.e. exports less re-exports.

fields.name: re_exports
fields.title: Re-exports
fields.description: [Float, RM] Re-exports, i.e. goods imported and subsequently exported without substantial transformation.

fields.name: imports_retained
fields.title: Retained Imports
fields.description: [Float, RM] Retained imports, i.e. imports less re-exports.

fields.name: total
fields.title: Total Trade
fields.description: [Float, RM] Total trade, i.e. exports plus imports.

fields.name: balance
fields.title: Trade Balance
fields.description: [Float, RM] Trade balance, i.e. exports less imports.

methodology: This dataset presents headline monthly trade data for Malaysia, comprising total exports, domestic exports, re-exports, total imports, retained imports, total trade, and trade balance. Users should note that this data only covers the trade in goods; data on trade in services is published on a quarterly frequency as part of the balance of payments publication. For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/trade-technotes).
caveat: Data for the most recent two months is provisional and subject to revision in future updates.
publication: [External Trade, Mar 2026](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/trade_2026-03), the latest edition of the monthly trade statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on trade](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/external-trade).
